title: Acyclic pro-etale hypercover model for a bounded-below module complex
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], with small pro-etale site and universes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $R$ be a sheaf of commutative rings on that site, $W$ a site object, and $U_\bullet\to W$ a hypercover whose terms are weakly contractible, with these notions as in [lem-weil-pbc-proetale-affine-acyclic-hypercover]. Let $E^\bullet$ be a complex of sheaves of $R$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with $E^q=0$ for $q<N$, for some integer $N$. Define the total complex of $B^{p,q}=E^q(U_p)$, $p\geq0$, by $\operatorname{Tot}(B)^r=\bigoplus_{p+q=r,\,p\geq0}E^q(U_p)$ and differential $\delta+(-1)^p d_E$ on $B^{p,q}$, where $\delta=\sum_{j=0}^{p+1}(-1)^j d_j^*$ is the alternating face restriction. Each displayed sum is finite because $N\leq q\leq r$. Then there is an isomorphism in $D(R(W)\text{-}\operatorname{Mod})$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], natural in $E^\bullet$, $$\operatorname{Tot}(B)\simeq R\Gamma(W,QE^\bullet).$$ Here $Q$ is localization at quasi-isomorphisms and $R\Gamma(W,-)$ means derived evaluation: replace $E^\bullet$ by a bounded-below complex $J^\bullet$ of injective module sheaves and a quasi-isomorphism $E^\bullet\to J^\bullet$, and take $J^\bullet(W)$. Existence of such representatives and their K-injectivity are as in [lem-weil-pbc-dplus-injective-representative]. In particular every quasi-isomorphism of bounded-below complexes induces a quasi-isomorphism of these total complexes.
